Towards mental time travel: a hierarchical memory for reinforcement learning agents ... Reinforcement learning agents often forget details of the past, especially after delays or distractor tasks. To address these limitations, we propose a Hierarchical Chunk Attention Memory (HCAM), which helps agents to remember the past in detail.
